scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: The proof is an existence argument using standard triangulation, simplicial approximation, homology-sphere, and covering-space facts. No numerical experiment is presented as proof.
limitations: No explicit minimal triangulations or face-list data are supplied.
The construction shows an unbounded gap but does not prove sharpness of the coefficient in the general persistence Quillen–McCord upper bound.
Novelty is supported by a bounded literature and record search, not a proof that no equivalent construction exists anywhere.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.scope: Exact existence family of integer-indexed finite-type persistence posets built from a Poincaré homology sphere, a degree-one map to the 3-sphere, and face posets.

title: An unbounded homotopy–homology interleaving gap under the persistence Quillen–McCord hypothesis
